environment: scripts/e2e.ps1 isolated temporary preview API/World/Vite; Docker SFU used for media checks; Playwright Chromium; test media devices are synthetic

assertions: legacy, v2, and v3 presenter preferences do not enable tools after the default change
active event controls remain hidden for an opted-out attendee until that attendee explicitly enables them in Settings
event controls appear after opt-in and the attendee can raise a hand
microphone/camera/screen-share controls and Enter nearby-chat entry remain available
explicit presenter opt-in/roster flow remains functional
attendance recording is unchecked by default after the organizer explicitly enables event tools
event Q&A and poll tools synchronize after each participant explicitly opts in
Korean and English landing, media preflight, campus, wardrobe, chat, map, participants, and settings views pass axe-core WCAG 2.1 A/AA scan
At 390x844, the wardrobe dialog stays within the viewport and the page has no horizontal overflow
The mobile icon-only Leave Space button has a localized accessible name
nearby delivery scope, emoji insertion, unread state
Enter opens map quick chat and sends nearby message
390px quick-chat control fits beside movement controls
composer remains visible above emulated virtual keyboard
lost acknowledgement reconnect replays the same message exactly once

checks.test: mobile and desktop participants exchange microphone and camera RTP over the SFU
assertions: bidirectional inbound audio and video RTP through SFU
presenter tools absent for both peers
no horizontal overflow on mobile
microphone/camera/screen-share RTP through SFU
screen-audio volume control changes the actual SCREEN_AUDIO element from 0 to 1
receiver is revoked after leaving nearby range
capture and media resources are cleaned up on leave
checks.test: real SFU carries microphone, camera and shared-screen RTP, then revokes distant receivers and cleans up on leave

limitations: Browser media uses synthetic Playwright devices; this is not a physical iOS/Android device check.
An actual HUFS SSO phone login and room join were not exercised.
